limits: Recurrent computation is CPU-only through the current NNJava adapter; no fused recurrent kernels or new shaders

Trainer checkpoints cover the zero-start-per-batch model; application-owned carried state must be persisted separately with stream position
Unrolled tapes use memory proportional to sequence length
Bidirectional wrappers, projection/peephole LSTMs, recurrent dropout and other variants remain extensions
Synthetic recall tasks establish correctness, not long-memory or performance claims
